outcome.technical: tests/test_guard_edits.py only (and two sentences of SECURITY.md, see below); hooks/_config.py unchanged. (1) _disk_record(fn, outer=False) added and _disk_calls built on it: the leaf measure as before, plus outer=True, which records a call only when no counted call is in progress, so a library call counts once on every host. (2) cf31/cf31b now drive _config._case_walk(top, parts, CONFIG_REL parts) directly, with _one_entry and _volume_folds stubbed and every question recorded. The walk's questions that are NOT substituted are recorded through _disk_record(outer=True), and each must be of a path spelled as the config's own below the fixture's top ('unsubstituted' list, empty). Rows assert the walk's word (folded/None) and its questions, relative to top. (3) cf31c/cf31d are new: the hook end to end on the real volume, with .claude existing and the config absent, for writes through .Claude/audit.config.json and .Claude/Audit.Config.json, agent and main session. Which volume it is comes from the disk (_swapped_exists for the folder's directory, _swapped_differs for .claude). Held (block/ask) where the volume folds, allowed where it tells case apart; the half that did not run is printed via _harness.skip as SKIPPED HERE. (4) cf32e is new: the real twin of cf31's both-names row on the disk-image pair, allowed because one of the two directories tells case apart. (5) cf29's budget is now counted outer, as the question's own source asks, with sum(now) <= sum(before) + one link question per CONFIG_REL component for a write that creates its file, and 0 otherwise. Both totals are printed. The call-for-call checks (now == today, now == off) keep the leaf measure. Runs: the suite on the folding system volume and on a case-sensitive APFS image (TMPDIR there; attached with -owners on so cf32's own nested image can mount) gives 147/147 on both; before the change, 144/144 folding and 143/144 on the image (cf31). Alternating timing in one window, folding volume: HEAD 98.0s and 97.9s for 144 cases, change 98.1s and 97.6s for 147 cases. Sweep runs: 85.5s before (one run), 132.0s after (one run, machine loaded by another session). Unrecorded run-test-gate.py SG2 --task SG2.4-xk1: GATE GREEN, exit 0 (affected/related included tests/test__refs.py, tests/test_journal_writes.py). ruff check and vermin -t=3.8- on the suite: exit 0. Dependants: tests/test_journal_writes.py imports _cap, _cases, _gen_label, _gen_spell, all unchanged; still correct, and green in the gate. .github/sweep-costs.json holds a relative weight for the file; runtime is unchanged by the alternating timing, so it is still correct. plugins/audit/hooks/guard-edits.py names the suite's path only; still correct. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (cf29 sentence) says the creating write pays a link question for the folder and one for the file and claims no total budget; still correct. SECURITY.md changed: its cf29 sentence claimed a creating write 'makes no more in total than before identity was asked', which was true only by the posix leaf measure. It now says 'beside those link questions ... counted as the calls the question's own source makes'. Its cf31 sentence now says the stub is given to the walk itself and names cf31c/cf31d. SECURITY.md is outside the task's files. The plan gate allowed the edit (no refusal printed). Windows-only lines (CI must confirm): cf31c's held half on NTFS, reached through realpath returning the stored-case .claude ('spelling') for the folder row and through _volume_folds(cdir) for the both-names row; and cf29's outer counts, which the windows log's own by-kind numbers predict as app.ts 6 vs 4 and cf-new.ts 4 vs 5 within an allowance of 2.
